faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ISI Kolkata Trainee (Library) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Trainee (Library) post at ISI Kolkata is 10th August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Trainee (Library) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Library & Information Science (M.LIS./ M. Lib.Sc.) or equivalent with First Class, along with a Bachelor's degree (under 10+2+3 system) from a recognized University/Institute with consistently good academic performance.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Trainee (Library) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Trainee (Library) post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Women and differently-abled candidates as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Trainee (Library) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Trainee (Library) position will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 15,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Trainee (Library) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Trainee (Library) post at the Indian Statistical Institute, Kolkata.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Trainee (Library) role?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on Academic Performance, Relevant Skills, and a Test and/or Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Trainee (Library) position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Trainee (Library) position is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q10. What are the preferred skills for the Trainee (Library) post?
faq.answer: Candidates with a working knowledge of MARC21, DDC, Web Design, DSpace, and Koha will be given preference for the Trainee (Library) position.
